_comment: Glossy ABS plastic: the moulded, high-gloss finish of appliance and toy housings. Opaque: a solid dielectric. The glossy sibling of the shipped ABS_Matte (same off-white base; colour is the Creator's tint, N5). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), fingerprints and dust, gated by the Grime mask. Gloss is what makes fingerprints and fine scratches show, so this is the article that judges Fingerprints01.
name: ABS_Glossy_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Physically Based has no ABS entry. Base colour follows the shipped ABS_Matte; roughness 0.15 for a moulded gloss finish; IOR 1.54, the literature value for ABS (ABS_Matte authors 1.46).
